title: Houthis Launch Broad Offensive on Saudi Arabia, Wounding 73
detail: The Houthis launched a coordinated broadside of drones and ballistic missiles against Saudi Arabia's southern region on September 8, 2026, striking Aramco facilities and military sites in Abha, Khamis Mushait, Jazan and Najran. Saudi military spokesman Major-General Turki al-Malki said at least 73 people were wounded, 'among them women and children.' The Jazan refinery — hit for the third time in 2026 — was taken offline again. Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree called it 'a broad operation,' framing it as retaliation for earlier Saudi aircraft and cruise-missile strikes on Houthi-held provinces. Saudi Foreign Minister Prince Faisal bin Farhan said the Kingdom 'will never hesitate to defend itself and its interests' while adding 'the road to diplomacy is not closed.' The WHO said at least 728 people have been killed or wounded in Yemen since August 23, most in Taiz and along the western coast.
